## Historical stage-evidence audit

**Scope.** The supplied files are stage-event logs, not images or full geometry. They support an audit of recorded transitions and aggregate scene statistics, but not a visual-quality judgment. No teacher or student calls, patch commands, acceptance decisions, H/M or mechanism updates, or object-level checks appear in these supplied files. Accordingly, this audit does not infer those events or feed code students or capability updates.

**Recorded ordering.** In the selected completed logs, validation *starts* before scene building; a build-completed event precedes render configuration and the aggregate `scene_built` event, then saving, loading, a second render configuration, and render start/completion. For example, SE0603, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H02/development/commons_192968130/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–13, records that sequence. It does **not** record a validation-completed or validation-passed event. Its seed controls Python random and NumPy only, not remote model sampling (line 1).

**Counterexample and later transitions.** SE0690, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H04/development/commons_109923183/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 1–3, ends at build start: it establishes neither build completion nor the cause of the interruption, and is not itself a recorded failed command. The later step SE0689, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H04/development/commons_109923183/1/steps/002/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–13, records a completed build, save, load and render. A subsequent completed build and render are recorded in SE0691, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H04/development/commons_109923183/1/steps/003/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 2–13. These are later recorded renders, not evidence of what was patched or why.

**Changes and counterexamples.** Aggregate statistics vary across some successive steps: SE0612, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H05/selection/bw_0017/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 6 and 12–13, records 288 meshes and a completed render; SE0613, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H05/selection/bw_0017/1/steps/003/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 6 and 12–13, records 439 meshes and another completed render. Conversely, SE0693, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H04/development/commons_192968130/1/steps/001/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 6 and 12–13, and SE0694, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/archive/scene/experiments/scene_rsi_v3/results/H04/development/commons_192968130/1/steps/003/stage_events.jsonl`, lines 6 and 12–13, report identical mesh, vertex and polygon counts with separate completed renders. Equal counts do not prove identical scenes; changed counts do not identify an edit or improvement.

**Evidentiary limits.** The logs report render settings and mesh totals, including zero remaining Boolean modifiers in the examples, but do not name parts or establish their relationships, pose, camera framing, lighting, materials, physical contact or visual fidelity. Render completion is not acceptance or quality validation; neither an `ok` flag nor AABB bounds, if encountered elsewhere, would establish fidelity or contact. No proposed action, teacher advice, student execution, failed command, or acceptance decision can be distinguished from these stage files because none is recorded in them. Original and publication copies, where present, must not be counted as independent trials. These selected examples do not establish a rule for all scenes.
